world_org_meetings.title: Southeast Asian leaders will call for peaceful resolutions of conflicts. Trump will join final talks
world_org_meetings.description: Southeast Asian leaders will gather in the Philippine capital this weekend for the annual ASEAN summit that will focus on global conflicts

world_org_meetings.title: New campaign against EU membership launches ahead of UK-EU summit
world_org_meetings.description: The launch of Stay Out comes as Andy Burnham prepares for talks with European leaders next week.

world_org_meetings.title: Albania’s PM says 2027 NATO summit will not be held in Tirana
world_org_meetings.description: Albania has faced criticism over low defence spending, as Rama is under pressure at home amid months of protests.

world_org_meetings.title: Turkey: Delegates arrive in Antalya as COP31 climate talks begin
world_org_meetings.description: The United Nations COP31 climate summit has opened in Antalya after a year marked by deadly heatwaves and devastating floods. Delegates face fresh challenges as the war in Iran disrupts global energy supplies.

world_org_meetings.title: Philippines: 'Trump out!' Women rally ahead of ASEAN summit
world_org_meetings.description: Women protesters took to the streets of Manila on Monday 9 November ahead of Donald Trump's visit for the 49th ASEAN summit. Carrying "Trump Out" placards, they also denounced a US-led initiative on semiconductors and critical minerals.

diplomatic_visits.title: Will U.S. travel pick up after midterm 'blue wave'? Not so fast, say these Canadians
diplomatic_visits.description: Travel from Canada to the U.S. dropped amid President Donald Trump's threats and trade war. While many Canadians view the Democratic Party's midterm election victory as an 'encouraging' sign, they say it's too soon to visit the U.S. again amid continued distrust.

diplomatic_visits.title: French-speaking nations hold a summit in Cambodia but an African conflict threatens a rift
diplomatic_visits.description: France's President Emmanuel Macron and other leaders are attending a biennial meeting of French-speaking countries and territories in Cambodia

diplomatic_visits.title: China to host first-ever trilateral meeting between Trump, Xi and Putin next week
diplomatic_visits.description: The three leaders are scheduled to meet on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen on Thursday, the White House confirmed. US officials said discussions will include nuclear weapons and the war in Iran, but that the war in Ukraine is unlikely to be on the agenda. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky warned the talks could prove a Yalta-like "redistribution of spheres of influence".

diplomatic_visits.title: Peru: Pope Leo XIV returns to his adopted homeland on historic visit
diplomatic_visits.description: Pope Leo XIV received a rapturous welcome in Peru, on 11 November, where he spent more than two decades as a missionary and bishop. Greeted by President Keiko Fujimori, he described his return as a homecoming.

diplomatic_visits.title: Southeast Asian leaders to meet as Trump visit highlights trade disruption
diplomatic_visits.description: ASEAN summit comes as US president embarks on Asia trip that will see him meet China's Xi.

elections.title: Colom wins Mississippi Senate race. And, White House warns Dems over future probes
elections.description: After more than a week of counting ballots, Scott Colom has narrowly won the Mississippi Senate seat. And, the White House has sent a letter warning Democrats who plan to investigate the administration.

elections.title: Nigeria: How the pcoming elections are influeced by the rise of AI disinformation
elections.description: As Nigeria inches closer to the 2027 polls, the use of artificial intelligence in the electoral process has prompted questions about integrity and institutional readiness. Can Nigerians trust their democratic processes?

elections.title: Gambia's Adama Barrow seeks third term
elections.description: In tonight's programme, Gambia's electoral commission has announced the five official candidates for the country's upcoming presidential election. President Adama Barrow is seeking a third term. Tensions continue to rise in Ethiopia following the federal government's appointment of a new head of the Western Tigray region. And the Dakar Youth Olympic Games come to a close after two weeks of intense competition.

elections.title: South Sudan postpones first-ever national elections until February
elections.description: The vote, first expected in 2022, will now be held on February 11, according to the country's election commission.

elections.title: After suffering its worst election result, what's next for the ANC — and for South Africa?
elections.description: A crushing local election result across the country has left South Africa's ruling ANC searching for answers. Experts say the vote reflects public frustration with service delivery failures — signaling a political shift.
